versions.changelog:
- Adds crew composition, productivity, and regional labor rate calculations.
- Includes detailed breakdowns for overhead, benefits, taxes, and insurance.
- Supports regional wage databases and crew cost estimation.
- Introduces factors for work type, site conditions, and weather to adjust productivity.
- Documentation improved with a clear overview and usage notes.

Initial release of Labor Rate calculator for construction projects.

- Calculates all-in labor rates including wages, benefits, taxes, insurance, overhead, and profit.
- Supports regional wage adjustments for several US cities and international locations.
- Allows custom labor crew compositions and calculates total crew hourly cost.
- Includes productivity factors for work type, site conditions, weather, and overtime.
- Provides standard construction crew templates for common tasks.
- Generates full rate tables by labor category in tabular (Pandas DataFrame) format.
